subject: [cam] DEC06 in production: 3 requests
body: (1) FYI build_plugins.sh now builds Slim.videodecoder (your one-line SLIMRegister definition never matched the old ^SLIMRegister grep): DEC06 sources + client/dec (DEC05) + mm21/n2_mm21.c + video/vt/n2vt_log.c, so n2vtd_client_dec05 is the default seam on the phone. Please check that is what you intend. (2) VT never retries a decoder StartSession, and vcodecd answers BUSY to a decoder OPEN while an encoder session is open (and is briefly absent during restart-on-switch): such a playback fails with no fallback. Proposal: vcodecd sets HELLO_OK.reserved bit0 = encoder session active / bit1 = decoder active (owner hw-ip/opus-enc4k), and your CreateInstance probe returns -12913 when bit0 is set; also retry DEC_OPEN on BUSY for ~500 ms inside StartSession. (3) The DEC05 client default timeout is 5 s per request (StartSession connect passes 0): consider 400 ms HELLO / 1 s per request so a hung daemon costs mediaserverd at most ~1 s. Also note the relay client id is per PROCESS: the encoder dylib now serialises its own requests, but an encode and a decode in mediaserverd at the same time can take each other replies; proper fix = flock in client/n2vcd_transport.c relay send->recv (proposed to the P03 owner).
